svg.aria-label: NeighbourAid logo and navigation refinement design board
svg.title: NeighbourAid — logo and navigation refinement
svg.desc: Static layered review board. Original raster logo, vector navigation icons, four selected-tab states per theme. Import into Figma manually; no native components, auto-layout, or prototype links are included.
svg.text: Compact 48×32 indicator. Equal touch targets. Labels outside the pill.
Two people move inward and settle; then the name and helper line appear.
People: 0–780 ms. Name: 640–920 ms. Helper line: 760–1040 ms.
Reduced motion: static. No loop, bounce, or delay to an emergency action.
Design review only · original logo retained · not app implementation
